thread.text:
Today: Lower ran heavier than the re-entry called for. Pendulum Squat swapped in for Squat (Barbell) — bodyweight × 8, 20kg × 8, 25kg × 8, 8 — a different movement, not on the barbell squat's scale. The RDL anchor, prescribed at a 70kg ceiling for two sets, landed at 80kg × 6, 6, 6 after a 50kg warm-up: three sets, 10kg over the ceiling, after six weeks off legs. Leg Press stood in for Leg Extension at 130kg × 8, 8, 8, well above the 80kg × 8, 8 it ran on 09-12. Kneeling Leg Curl held at 10kg × 8, 8, 8, matching 10-02.

Trend: Kneeling Leg Curl has now given 8s at 10kg across three sessions — 09-12, 10-02, today — the 7.5kg re-entry never happened and the load still sits a rep under the 8-10 top. The RDL's 80kg × 6, 6, 6 beats 10-02's tired 80kg × 5, 7, 5 and reads as well as 09-12's 70kg × 8, 8, 8, just at a heavier load after the long layoff.

Sleep: 7h03 against the week's 7h27, HRV 76ms against 89ms — both a touch below the recent run, though with only three nights there's no normal yet to measure it against. Nothing in today's lifts looks held back by it.

Next session: Upper A, Mon 16 Nov. Incline leads at 67.5kg for three working sets plus the back-off; 8s across all three earns 70kg. Pull-ups go second with the 5kg added — 24 total last time, three sessions at 27+ locks it in. Lateral raise stays at 8kg, chasing 20 clean holds on all three sets.

Rounding: Seated Calf Raise and Hanging Leg Raise haven't shown up in a Lower entry since 10-02 — worth a check whether they're still happening off-log.

Question: RDL went three sets at 80kg instead of the two-set, 70kg-ceiling re-entry — how did the hamstrings feel, given the full three-set 80kg return was meant to wait for Sunday?
